nodes.label: DeepLinkService
nodes.rationale: Handles URL schema parsing for tipboxapp://, initial URL handling from killed state, notification data parsing, and navigation route mapping

nodes.label: NotificationStore (Zustand)
nodes.rationale: Client state for realtime notification via Socket.IO, optimistic updates, grouping state, unread count cache. Zustand=CLIENT STATE, React Query=SERVER STATE

nodes.label: NotificationEventService
nodes.rationale: Event-driven architecture for dispatching/listening to notification events with type-based, priority-based, and wildcard listeners

nodes.label: NotificationGroupingService
nodes.rationale: Debouncing (1 min window), aggregation, rate limiting, group template generation. Groupable types: POST_LIKED, POST_COMMENTED, COMMENT_LIKED, NEW_TRUSTER, POST_SHARED

nodes.label: NotificationStateSync
nodes.rationale: Syncs Zustand store with React Query cache, handles optimistic updates, cache invalidation, periodic sync every 5 seconds

nodes.label: SearchModal Animation Optimization
nodes.rationale: Replaced 50ms setTimeout with requestAnimationFrame (16ms), tuned spring config (damping:15, stiffness:300, mass:0.3), reduced timing from 200ms to 150ms for ~40% faster animation

nodes.label: GlobalBottomSheet Animation Optimization
nodes.rationale: Disabled enableDynamicSizing, switched to fixed snapPoints for consistent performance, reduced layout calculation overhead

nodes.label: Hybrid Navigation Architecture (Context-Switching + Deep-Dive)
nodes.rationale: Replaced shared screens pattern (36 instances across 6 tabs) with GlobalStackGroup (6 screens), achieving 83% memory reduction, type-safe navigation via ROOT_ROUTES constants, and 2-level nesting vs previous 3-level

nodes.label: NavigationService
nodes.rationale: Centralized navigation logic with type-safe navigate() calls, queue pattern for pending navigation when container not ready

nodes.label: Drawer Gesture Conflict Fix
nodes.rationale: Dynamic drawer gesture control: disable swipe when nested stack depth > 0 or on detail screens to prevent conflict with back gesture

nodes.label: Tab State Persistence Fix
nodes.rationale: Added unmountOnBlur:false to TabNavigator and maintainVisibleContentPosition to FlashList to preserve scroll position across tab switches

nodes.label: Notification Routing Queue Fix
nodes.rationale: FIFO queue pattern for pending navigation items when NavigationContainer is not ready, preventing race conditions

nodes.label: AuthNavigator Stack
nodes.rationale: Auth flow: Welcome -> Login -> Register -> ForgotPassword -> VerifyCode -> ResetPassword -> SetupProfile -> SelectCategories

nodes.label: BrandHistoryScreen (3-tab tabbed UI)
nodes.rationale: 3 tabs (Posts, Polls, Badges) with PagerView horizontal swipe. Uses /brands/{brandId}/history, /brands/{brandId}/feed, /brands/{brandId}/surveys

nodes.label: EditHighlightBadgesScreen
nodes.rationale: 4 highlight badge slots (was max 3), tabs for Event Badges and Collections. Save endpoint TODO. Backend needs max 4 badge slots

nodes.label: Cursor Pagination Bug
nodes.rationale: Backend returns previous page items when cursor is provided instead of items after cursor. FeedTab worst case: same data with same cursor returned, causing infinite loop risk. Frontend duplicate filter mitigates but wastes bandwidth

nodes.label: Messages DB Schema
nodes.rationale: PostgreSQL messages table with thread_id, sender_id, message_type, reply_to_message_id, status tracking (sending/sent/delivered/read), editing support, and full-text search index on Turkish locale

nodes.label: Threads DB Schema
nodes.rationale: 1-on-1 thread model with participant_1_id, participant_2_id (unique constraint), per-participant unread counts, last_message tracking

nodes.label: Support Requests DB Schema
nodes.rationale: Support request lifecycle: pending -> accepted/rejected/canceled -> awaiting_completion -> completed/reported. Tracks from_user, to_user, support_type, amount

nodes.label: Global Search API (GET /search)
nodes.rationale: Unified search across users, brands, products with keyword parameter. Returns userData, brandData, productData arrays

nodes.label: Catalog Product Search API
nodes.rationale: GET /catalog/product-groups/:id/products for single group search, GET /catalog/products/search requested for global product search across all groups

nodes.label: GlobalBottomSheetProvider Pattern
nodes.rationale: Proposed App.tsx-level Context/Provider for centralized bottom sheet management. Solves: tab bar not hiding, overlay issues, z-index problems across 26+ files. Uses openBottomSheet/closeBottomSheet API

nodes.label: React Query Caching Strategy
nodes.rationale: 4-tier caching: Tab-based (2min stale), Screen-based (5min stale), List data (3min stale), Static/Reference (24h stale). Global defaults: staleTime=5min, gcTime=10min, refetchOnMount=false

nodes.label: Catalog Context Posts API Quick Start
nodes.norm_label: catalog context posts api quick start

nodes.label: Smart Context Endpoint (GET /catalog/context/{contextId}/posts)
nodes.rationale: Single endpoint handles all context types (product, sub_category, product_group, main_category) by auto-detecting contextId format. Returns contextType in response

nodes.label: Catalog Hierarchy (5 Levels)
nodes.rationale: 5-level hierarchy: Categories -> Category -> SubCategory -> ProductGroup -> Product -> ProductVariant. Each level supports post creation and breadcrumb navigation

nodes.label: NotificationNavigationService
nodes.rationale: Central mapping from notification types to navigation screens (NOTIFICATION_NAVIGATION_MAP). Type-safe, with parameter validation and fallback support

nodes.label: Badge System (Achievement, Bridge, Event)
nodes.rationale: Three badge categories: achievement (user actions), bridge/brand (brand platform bridging), event (event participation). Cursor-based pagination. BadgeRarity: Usual|Rare|Epic|Legendary. NFT claim support via nftAddress

nodes.label: Modal Overlay Pattern for Context Menu
nodes.norm_label: modal overlay pattern for context menu

nodes.label: @gorhom/bottom-sheet v5 Library
nodes.rationale: Custom Global Manager chosen over BottomSheetModal for automatic tab bar hiding, consistent behavior, and future customization flexibility.

nodes.label: GluestackProvider StyledProvider Fix
nodes.rationale: Nested GluestackProvider caused StyledProvider error. Fix: moved GluestackProvider before GlobalBottomSheetProvider in composeProviders order and removed redundant nested wrap.

nodes.label: composeProviders (Provider Ordering)
nodes.rationale: composeProviders uses reduceRight so providers wrap right-to-left. GluestackProvider must come before GlobalBottomSheetProvider so bottom sheet content has access to styled context.

nodes.label: Google Auth iOS Invalid Request Fix
nodes.norm_label: google auth ios invalid request fix

nodes.label: Google Auth Token and Session Management
nodes.norm_label: google auth token and session management

nodes.label: TokenService (SecureStore)
nodes.rationale: Tokens stored in Expo SecureStore (encrypted), cached in memory for performance. API interceptor auto-attaches access token and handles 401 refresh.

nodes.label: AuthProvider Initialization Delay
nodes.rationale: isAuthReady blocks all rendering. SecureStore token read takes 200-500ms. Splash screen adds 100ms. Total 400-800ms delay before header visible.

nodes.label: Header Performance Fixes (useMemo removal, collapsable)
nodes.rationale: Removed useMemo for trivial computations (isDark ternary), added collapsable={false} to prevent RN view collapsing, and ensured header renders first in DOM order. Net improvement ~55-100ms.

nodes.label: Safe Array Access Pattern for TanStack Query
nodes.rationale: 60% of Hermes crashes from array.flatMap/map without null checks on paginated query data. Standard pattern: check pages existence, Array.isArray guard, null-coalescing in flatMap, and useMemo wrapper.
nodes.norm_label: safe array access pattern for tanstack query

nodes.label: Domain Service Pattern (NotificationService, MessageService, EventService)
nodes.rationale: Socket and push events route through domain services, not UI. Services decide state updates and navigation. UI is passive. Prevents race conditions, flood rendering, and lost navigation.

nodes.label: Pending Navigation Queue
nodes.rationale: If navigation not ready, actions are queued in pendingNavigation Zustand state and consumed when navigation becomes available. Also defers navigation when user is busy (form, payment).

nodes.label: Notification Idempotency Control
nodes.rationale: lastProcessedEventIds Set (max 100, FIFO) prevents duplicate socket+push notifications from being processed twice.

nodes.label: CachedImage Component
nodes.rationale: Wraps expo-image with auto URL normalization (localhost fix), default memory-disk cache policy, placeholder support, and recyclingKey for FlatList performance.

nodes.label: Hierarchical Feed Logic (Sub Category > Product Group > Product)
nodes.rationale: Feed aggregates posts from child hierarchy levels. Sub-category and product-group levels auto-filter out Experience/Update/Benchmark. Product level shows all types.
nodes.norm_label: hierarchical feed logic (sub category > product group > product)

nodes.label: 4-Level Nested Navigator Pattern
nodes.rationale: NavigationContainer > DrawerNavigator > MainNavigator > TabNavigator with 6 tabs. Each tab has its own stack navigator. Shared screens (Profile, Post, Wallet, etc.) auto-registered via buildFeatureStack.

nodes.label: RootNavigator (DetailsGroup + ModalsGroup)
nodes.rationale: Root stack has Auth, App(Drawer>Tabs), DetailsGroup (Post, Profile, Wallet, Bookmarks, Marketplace, MessageDetail, SupportMessageDetail) and ModalsGroup (Settings, MoreSchoise). This avoids navigation stack bloat.

nodes.label: Feed Scroll-to-Top Problem
nodes.rationale: tabPress event cannot reach FeedScreen FlatList due to 7-level nesting. FeedListContext is local to FeedScreen. Proposed solution: Zustand store holding scrollToTop function closure.

nodes.label: NotificationWorker
nodes.rationale: Queue-based async processing via BullMQ ensures notification performance scales without blocking the main request cycle

nodes.label: NotificationFactory
nodes.rationale: Template-based notification builder centralizes notification templates for consistent messaging across 30+ notification types

nodes.label: react-native-collapsible-tab-view
nodes.rationale: Already installed v8.0.1; chosen over manual FlatList because it simultaneously solves nested scroll, sticky tab bar, swipe-between-tabs, and independent scroll context problems

nodes.label: notifyOnChangeProps Optimization
nodes.rationale: Excluding isFetchingNextPage from notifyOnChangeProps cuts per-page-load renders from 2 to 1 per tab, yielding 50% render reduction

nodes.label: Tab-Based Caching Strategy
nodes.rationale: 2-minute staleTime for tab data balances freshness with instant tab switching; gcTime of 10 minutes keeps data in memory for quick return navigation

nodes.label: Screen-Based Caching Strategy
nodes.rationale: 5-minute staleTime for screen data ensures back-navigation feels instant while detail data stays reasonably current

nodes.label: Smart Refresh Pattern
nodes.rationale: Pull-to-refresh shows cached data immediately while fetching fresh data in background; user never sees loading spinner on pull-to-refresh

nodes.label: React Hook Form Migration Strategy
nodes.rationale: Controller pattern chosen over FormProvider/setValue because it preserves existing child component APIs while adding form state management; incremental migration enabled by screen-by-screen approach

nodes.label: Context Scope Isolation Pattern
nodes.rationale: React Context only flows downward in the component tree, not the navigation tree. Navigation tree parent-child relationships do not grant context access. Event-based communication is the recommended bridge between navigation events and component-tree contexts.

nodes.label: Zustand Persist Debounce
nodes.rationale: Debounce on AsyncStorage writes (300ms) prevents every state change from triggering I/O, reducing battery drain and GC pressure from frequent string serialization

nodes.label: FlashList Migration
nodes.rationale: Shopify FlashList provides 50-70% faster rendering and lower memory usage compared to FlatList; target screens are ProfileScreen, NotificationsScreen, ExploreScreen

nodes.label: Socket.IO Real-time Communication
nodes.rationale: Socket.IO chosen for real-time messaging with automatic reconnection (5 attempts), JWT token auth via headers, and graceful fallback to REST API when socket connection fails. Non-critical design: app continues working without socket.

nodes.label: JWT Token Authentication for Socket
nodes.rationale: Socket connection uses JWT token sent via auth.token and extraHeaders.Authorization. Token stored in SecureStore. Token refresh does not auto-update socket - reconnection needed.

nodes.label: PagerView Tab Swiping Pattern
nodes.rationale: Uses react-native-pager-view with Reanimated shared values for native swipe gestures. Progress shared value (0 to N) drives tab indicator position and label color interpolation on UI thread via worklets. Used in InboxScreen, reusable for any multi-tab screen.

nodes.label: Top Sheet / SearchModal Component
nodes.rationale: Top sheet (inverse of bottom sheet) uses Reanimated spring animations with translateY from -MODAL_HEIGHT to 0. Handler placed at bottom for upward swipe-to-dismiss. Thread safety ensured via worklet directives and runOnJS for state setters. Gesture disabled during animation to prevent crashes.

nodes.label: Translation Cache Service
nodes.rationale: 7-day TTL cache in AsyncStorage with content hash checks. Cache-first strategy: second translation reads from cache (fast). Free tier: 500K chars/month (~2500 posts). API key stored in mobile .env for TestFlight phase, must move to backend for production.

nodes.label: Support Session Price Endpoint
nodes.rationale: Support session price uses TIPS currency with minimum 50 TIPS constraint and 10-day cooldown between price changes.

nodes.label: WalletService (Web2 Wallet System)
nodes.rationale: Web2-first wallet with Web3-ready architecture. Motor swap design: same API surface (endpoints, hooks, transaction model) works for both backend ledger and future Thirdweb blockchain. Ledger-based balance calculated from confirmed transactions. Transaction lifecycle: created->pending->confirmed/failed. Wallet identifier uses fake address now, real blockchain address later.

nodes.label: Circular Dependency Resolution Patterns
nodes.rationale: Two patterns used: (1) Lazy import with require() to break appStore<->interceptors cycle. (2) Context extraction to separate file to break GlobalBottomSheetProvider<->GlobalBottomSheet cycle. Enforced unidirectional dependency: Service->Store (not reverse).

nodes.label: WhatsApp Context Menu Implementation
nodes.rationale: Long-press context menu with reaction bar and action menu. Uses measureInWindow for exact screen coordinates (not parent-relative measure). Modal used instead of absolute positioning to work outside scroll views. Reanimated spring animations for open/close. Haptic feedback on iOS. Fallback chain: measureInWindow -> event coordinates -> approximate position.
